items.title: August Laurent Interview, 1960-03-21
items.q: It was a Valette... Peterson looked that up in the book about that Valette.

ctx.x: That has a beautiful tone. This clarinet, I don't know, it's in French for me. It's made in Paris. France, let's see, it was a Valette.
Did we see that one? I don't know that name. That's what I'm telling you. Oh, yeah. V-A-L-E-T-T-E. Yeah, Valette. Valette.
Well, I had Peterson to look that up. Peterson looked that up in the book about that Valette. He found it in his book. Made in Paris, France.
